people.name: Bethany
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Mary, Martha, and Lazarus.

people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
translations.bsb: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
translations.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
